title: Public-Seed Feistel Security for Unpredictable Sources
summary: The available security result covers reset-secure sources; the open task is to establish the analogous guarantee for unpredictable sources.

formal_statement.body: Prove, for a Feistel-based public-seed pseudorandom permutation construction, a theorem establishing CP-sequential indifferentiability or psPRP security for unpredictable sources, analogous to the available result for reset-secure sources. The available result applies only to reset-secure sources, so the unresolved task is to obtain the corresponding security guarantee when the source is unpredictable.

scope.domain: This concerns design and security analysis of Feistel-based public-seed pseudorandom permutations.
parameters: Feistel-based public-seed pseudorandom permutation construction (target construction)
reset-secure sources (source class covered by the available result)
scope.unresolved_remainder: Establish the corresponding CP-sequential indifferentiability or psPRP security guarantee for unpredictable sources, analogous to the available result for reset-secure sources.

progress.summary: The source notes that its result handles only reset-secure sources and explicitly leaves a similar result for unpredictable sources open.
citation_labels: Pratik Soni et al., Public-Seed Pseudorandom Permutations
